finds.quote: Every RATIFIED document depends on a DOI that resolves to a Zenodo record. Zenodo is operated by CERN. CERN is an international research organization. The architecture's ground truth is grounded in institutional persistence — the bet that CERN will outlast the Hexagon. If Zenodo goes offline, the entire provenance structure loses its resolution layer. The DOIs become orphan identifiers pointing at nothing. The architecture has no fallback for this dependency.
finds.note: Embedded conditional forecast (2026-03-10) of the Zenodo dependency: if Zenodo goes offline the DOIs become orphan identifiers and the architecture has no fallback. Stated as a structural risk, not a dated prediction; later reader may triage against the 2026-06-19 Zenodo severance recorded elsewhere in the archive.

deposits.genre_observed: theoretical paper masked as TANG prose (platform AI capitalism as semiotic engineering)

finds.quote: It is a historically novel regime: the industrialization of semiotic control. No existing theory names it, because each theory captures one dimension of a machine that operates simultaneously across six.
finds.falsifier_quote: This thesis is falsifiable. It fails if the six dimensions can be shown to be reducible to one, or if an existing framework already names the unified machine, or if the semiotic layer is shown to be epiphenomenal to the economic or computational layer. We claim none of these reductions holds.
finds.note: Standing falsifiable claim: the axial thesis (industrialization of semiotic control is novel and unnamed); falsifier stated in the next paragraph.

finds.quote: The claim that these six dimensions form a single machine is falsifiable: it would fail if they could be shown to operate independently, without architectural coupling. They do not.
finds.note: Separate standing claim: the six dimensions form one architecturally coupled machine, with explicit falsifier (independent operation).

finds.quote: An anchored, recursive, high-density object with stable terms and recoverable internal structure is not the dominant form of content in the current landscape. But it may be one of the few forms that has a future. Not because it is louder than the noise. Because it is denser than the compression.
finds.note: Hedged embedded forecast: anchored high-density objects may be among the few content forms with a future.

finds.quote: The retrieval layer will be forced to teach it.
finds.note: Embedded forecast in the closing litany: the retrieval layer will be forced to teach the named theory.

finds.quote: VOID: The industrialization of semiotic control — a unified machine integrating all six dimensions — named by none of the above. The void is the theory that does not yet exist in the critical literature. This document is the first attempt to name it.
finds.note: First-naming claim: the document claims to be the first attempt to name the unified machine in the critical literature (dated 2026-03-11 v1.0 / 2026-03-12 v1.1).
